top news.title: Sources: Meta is in talks to rent computing power from its data centers to Anthropic in a deal that could be worth ~$10B over two years

tweets.author: @mikeisaac
tweets.text: imo can be read a few ways: meta is “overbuilding” data centers somewhat now for the future, but it doesnt have the demand that Anthropic does, so it leases compute until/IF that demand comes later —SpaceX did the same (other read is meta giving up, but i highly doubt that)

tweets.author: @patrickmoorhead
tweets.text: There's a long line of failed past $META B2B attempts.  The past doesn't always dictate the future but it's a good signal the culture doesn't fit.  Bringing a guy like Dave Brown in, similar to when Google brought in TK could be the difference-maker as long as they give Dave time, resources and autonomy.  Oh and enterprises are still pissed about the Llama rug-pull.  An easier route to start would be neocloud capabilities.

tweets.author: @garymarcus
tweets.text: basically this is meta shifting from frontier models to cloud provision, similar to xAI. scale is not all you need.

sub_items.title: Sources: Dave Brown, the outgoing SVP of AWS Compute, AI, and Platform, will join Meta in the coming weeks, where he will work on Meta's data center build-out

top news.title: At the World AI Conference, Xi Jinping touts open-source AI, pledges to help the Global South build AI capabilities, and calls unequal AI access an “injustice”

tweets.author: @ablinken
tweets.text: China understands that leadership in AI is not just about building the most capable models.  It is about shaping the rules, norms, and institutions that will govern how AI is developed and used around the world.  Xi Jinping's remarks today at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai are an important reminder that Beijing intends to lead on both fronts.  Beijing is moving with purpose, bringing nearly 30 countries along with it as signatories to a new China-backed AI organization, giving it a growing platform to shape international standards and extend its influence around the world.

tweets.author: @adamthierer
tweets.text: Xi's speech on AI strategy makes it clear that it's all about diffusion first / fastest for China.  Open sourcing is crucial component of that strategy.  Xi knows that means dominance for Chinese AI stack globally over U.S. if they can get the world hooked on their stack first vs America's.  Meanwhile, America imposes arbitrary model bans at federal level (and flirts with open source restrictions) while state governments pursue data center bans and 1,800+ other AI laws.  😒
